label: Premium app (instant, themeable)
description: A premium, self-contained app skeleton — Tailwind (CDN), login/signup, dashboard shell, settings, nav, 6 swappable color palettes, AND a curated set of CDN libraries pre-wired: Alpine.js (interactivity), AOS (scroll animations), Chart.js (a themed chart), and lucide (icons). No build step; previews instantly. The AI fills the blank content area with the user's idea.
notesBlurb: PREMIUM app skeleton (static-premium): a complete, styled, instantly-previewing app. ALREADY WORK: login/signup (mock localStorage auth), dashboard layout + sidebar nav (lucide icons), settings, 6-palette theming via [data-theme], AND premium CDN libraries — Alpine.js (e.g. the topbar dropdown; use x-data/x-show, add x-cloak), AOS (data-aos scroll animations, AOS.init in script.js), Chart.js (a palette-themed chart via renderChart() in script.js — recolors on theme change), lucide (icons via <i data-lucide>, lucide.createIcons()). Your job: customize the BLANK content slot in index.html (region marked 'AI: BUILD THE APP'S MAIN FEATURE HERE'), relabel the placeholder stat cards + the chart's data, set the app name (data-app-name), add pages by copying the page/nav pattern. Reuse the components + color tokens (bg-surface, border-line, bg-brand text-brand-fg, .nav-item, inputs) and the libs already loaded — for charts reuse renderChart, for interactivity use Alpine, for icons use <i data-lucide>. Do NOT rebuild auth/layout/nav, restyle from scratch, swap Tailwind out, touch the palette system, remove the theme picker, or add ES-module scripts (the preview only runs global/UMD CDN libs). Keep it runnable at every step.
